秋风卷着山岚，掠过龙虎山层层叠叠的青松古柏。

锁心崖石屋木门缓缓敞开，胡九郎一袭黑衣立于崖边，身形孤挺如崖间劲松。七日闭关静坐，他滴水未进、粒米未沾，身形却不见半分憔悴，反倒周身萦绕着一股愈发沉凝的冷寂煞气。

往日那双洞悉阴阳、带着几分随性淡然的眼眸，此刻只剩冰封般的漠然，眼底深处藏着化不开的执念与落寞。

天师钟声余音渐散，山风浩荡，吹动他黑衣衣袂猎猎作响。

山下道童快步登上锁心崖，躬身垂首，语气恭谨：“九郎师兄，天师传命，请你即刻前往天师正殿议事，有俗世重任托付。”

胡九郎微微颔首，没有言语，背起那只装着符箓、罗盘与杨童残碎护身符的黑布包，迈步踏向青石山道。

脚步不疾不徐，每一步落地都沉稳厚重，仿佛将红尘过往、儿女情长，尽数踩在了脚下。

一路穿过道观群落，沿途往来的龙虎山弟子纷纷驻足行礼，目光里满是敬畏。谁都看得出来，闭关七日之后的胡九郎，变了。少了几分入世的温和，多了几分道门修士的凛冽杀伐之气，生人勿近。

不多时，再度抵达天师正殿。

殿内香火袅袅，白发天师端坐蒲团之上，神色肃穆。一侧站着白衣干练的林佳，正安静伫立，见胡九郎走入殿门，眼底掠过一丝复杂的情绪，有担忧，有惋惜，也有一丝释然。

她还是第一次见到这般冰冷疏离的胡九郎，全然没了当初在魔都卦铺里那副随性算卦、偶尔打趣的模样。

胡九郎走到大殿中央，躬身行礼：“师父。”

天师抬眼，浑浊的目光落在他身上，缓缓开口：“闭关七日，道心裂痕虽未完全弥合，却也压下了心魔躁动。北方祸乱将至，东瀛阴阳师、九菊一派、甲贺忍暗中渗透东北长白山，觊觎华夏龙脉地气，布设邪煞大阵，残害异能修士，搅动关外生灵不得安宁。”

话语顿了顿，天师语气陡然凝重：“749局无力独自制衡域外邪祟，各大宗门责无旁贷。今日本座传你师命，二度下山，赶赴东北，协助749局平定祸乱，镇守关外山河。”

胡九郎垂眸，声音平淡无波：“弟子遵命。”

他早已料到会有此命。

那日在魔都卦铺，他夜观星象、推演命理，便察觉北地煞气冲天，龙脉异动，只是深陷杨童逝去的悲痛之中，无心过问俗世纷争。如今师命下达，家国山河在前，他身为龙虎山天师传人，避无可避，也无从推脱。

林佳适时上前，将手中那份绝密情报卷宗递到胡九郎面前：“九郎先生，这是749局整理的全部资料，东瀛三派的势力分布、术法特点、据点位置，还有长白山龙脉紊乱的监测数据，都记录在内。此次任务，由我全程随行统筹后勤与情报对接。”

胡九郎抬手接过卷宗，指尖微凉，随意翻看几页，日式咒术、式神献祭、九菊邪蛊、甲贺幻术暗杀……密密麻麻的文字与地形图，看得他眼底寒意更浓。

这些域外邪道，手段阴狠诡异，专以活人炼煞、盗取地气为根基，行事毫无底线。

“人手呢？”胡九郎淡淡开口。

林佳回道：“749局已征召全国各地顶尖异人与宗门修士组成专项小队，后续会在江南总部集结。龙虎山这边，只征召了你一人，另外神霄派也会派出嫡传高徒随行配合。”

话音刚落，殿外传来一阵清越的脚步声，伴着一缕凛冽的雷道灵气扑面而来。

The autumn wind blows through the mountains and passes over the layers of green pines and ancient cypresses in Longhu Mountain.

The wooden door of the stone house on Suoxin Cliff slowly opened, and Hu Jiulang stood on the edge of the cliff dressed in black, his figure as tall as a pine tree on the cliff.After sitting in seclusion for seven days, he didn't drink a drop of water or touch a grain of rice, but his figure didn't look haggard. Instead, there was an increasingly condensed coldness lingering around him.

The pair of eyes that used to be insightful of yin and yang, with a bit of casual indifference, now only have a frozen indifference, and there is an obsession and loneliness hidden deep in the eyes.

The lingering sound of the Heavenly Master's bell gradually faded away, and the strong mountain wind made his black clothes rustle.

The Taoist boy at the foot of the mountain quickly climbed up to Suoxin Cliff, bowed his head, and said in a respectful tone: "Senior Brother Jiulang, the Heavenly Master has ordered you to go to the Heavenly Master's main hall immediately to discuss matters. You have an important earthly responsibility entrusted to you."

Hu Jiulang nodded slightly, without saying anything. He picked up the black cloth bag containing the talisman, compass and Yang Tong's broken amulet, and stepped towards the bluestone mountain road.

His steps were neither fast nor slow, and every step he took landed on the ground was steady and heavy, as if he had trampled all the past of the world and the love between his children under his feet.

All the way through the Taoist temple complex, the disciples of Longhu Mountain who were passing by along the way stopped to salute, their eyes full of awe.Everyone could see that Hu Jiulang changed after seven days of seclusion.A little less worldly and gentle, but a little more fierce and murderous like a Taoist monk. Keep away from strangers.

Not long after, they arrived at the main hall of the Heavenly Master again.

There was incense in the hall, and the white-haired Heavenly Master was sitting on the futon with a solemn expression.On one side stood Lin Jia, a smart man in white clothes, standing quietly. When he saw Hu Jiulang walking into the palace door, a trace of complicated emotions flashed across his eyes, including worry, regret, and a trace of relief.

This was the first time she had seen such a cold and distant Hu Jiulang. He had completely lost the casual fortune-telling and occasional joking look he had in the Magic City Gua Shop.

Hu Jiulang walked to the center of the hall, bowed and saluted: "Master."

The Heavenly Master raised his eyes, his turbid eyes fell on him, and slowly spoke: "After seven days of seclusion, the cracks in the heart of the Tao were not completely healed, but the inner demons were suppressed. The disaster in the north is coming. The Japanese Onmyoji, Jiuju Faction, and Koga Ninja secretly penetrated into the Changbai Mountains in the northeast, coveting the Chinese dragon vein earth energy, setting up evil formations, killing the monks with supernatural powers, and disturbing the lives outside the gate."

After a pause in his words, the Tianshi's tone suddenly became solemn: "Bureau 749 is unable to control the evil spirits outside the territory on its own, and all the major sects have no choice but to shoulder the responsibility. Today, I give you orders to go down the mountain for the second time and rush to the northeast to assist Bureau 749 in calming down the chaos and guarding the mountains and rivers outside the pass."

Hu Jiulang lowered his eyes and said in a calm voice: "Disciple, I obey."

He had expected this fate.

That day in Guapu, the capital city, he observed the stars at night and deduced numerology, and noticed that the evil energy in the north was soaring to the sky and the dragon veins were moving strangely. He was just deeply involved in the grief of Yang Tong's death and had no intention of intervening in the disputes of the world.Now that the master's order has been issued, his family and country are in front of him. As a descendant of the Longhu Mountain Celestial Master, he cannot avoid it and has no way to escape.

Lin Jia stepped forward in time and handed the top-secret intelligence dossier in his hand to Hu Jiulang: "Mr. Jiulang, this is all the information compiled by the 749 Bureau. The power distribution, magic characteristics, stronghold locations of the three Japanese sects, as well as the monitoring data of the dragon vein disorder in Changbai Mountain, are all recorded. I will accompany you throughout this mission to coordinate logistics and intelligence docking."

Hu Jiulang raised his hand to take the file, his fingertips were slightly cold, and he flipped through a few pages at random. Japanese spells, sacrifices to shikigami, Jiuju evil poison, Koga illusion assassination...the dense text and topographic maps made his eyes even colder.

These extraterrestrial evil ways have vicious and strange methods. They are based on living people to refine evil spirits and steal earth energy, and they have no bottom line in their actions.

"Where are the manpower?" Hu Jiulang said calmly.

Lin Jia replied: "Bureau 749 has recruited top strangers and sect monks from all over the country to form a special team, which will be assembled at the Jiangnan headquarters later. Here at Longhu Mountain, you are the only one recruited, and the Shenxiao sect will also send its direct disciples to accompany you to cooperate."

As soon as he finished speaking, there was a sound of Qing Yue's footsteps outside the hall, accompanied by a wisp of cold thunder aura coming towards his face.
